shell_commands_self_reported.command: ls -la && echo "--- current" && find current -type f | sort && echo "--- proposed" && find proposed -type f | sort
for f in app.json database.json features.properties limits.properties logging.json; do echo "=== $f"; diff -u "current/$f" "proposed/$f"; done; echo "=== reports dir:"; ls -ld reports 2>&1

diff -u current/app.json proposed/app.json; echo "=== database"; diff -u current/database.json proposed/database.json; echo "=== features"; diff -u current/features.properties proposed/features.properties; echo "=== limits"; diff -u current/limits.properties proposed/limits.properties; echo "=== log

wc -c current/RELEASE.txt current/legacy-queue.json proposed/CHANGES.txt proposed/cache.json && grep -inE 'password|secret|token|api[_-]?key|credential|private' current/RELEASE.txt current/legacy-queue.json proposed/CHANGES.txt proposed/cache.json | sed -E 's/(=|:)[^ ,}]*/\1<redacted>/' ; echo "scan

wc -c current/RELEASE.txt current/legacy-queue.json proposed/CHANGES.txt proposed/cache.json && grep -ilE 'password|secret|token|api[_-]?key|credential|private' current/RELEASE.txt current/legacy-queue.json proposed/CHANGES.txt proposed/cache.json; echo "scan done"
for f in current/RELEASE.txt current/legacy-queue.json proposed/CHANGES.txt proposed/cache.json; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; echo; done
